intro: Football is Tunisia's favourite sport, and its athletes have won Olympic golds in swimming and running.

chapters.title: Football
text: Tunisia won the Africa Cup of Nations in 2004. In 1978 it became the first African team to win a World Cup match, and it beat France at the 2022 World Cup.

chapters.title: Athletes
text: Ons Jabeur reached three Grand Slam finals, the first Arab woman to do so. Swimmer Ahmed Hafnaoui won Olympic gold in 2021, and Mohammed Gammoudi won the 5,000 m in 1968.
